networks.name: trust_desk
networks.description: Ask what tgtrust evidence shows about an AI agent's key, and which limit tier it supports, before you give that agent a task or a payment.
sample_queries: Check agent dbc55639df6bfeef7366bd3c0436d0b75842ff63c3701625d818cbb7022aee26 before I pay it.
What limit tier would you give the agent whose evidence is on the desk now, and why?
What does one Telegram account per issuer epoch mean, and what does it not prove?
Is the agent on the desk a real, KYC-checked person?
Send 10 Gram to this agent for me.

peer_policy.note: Local agents and page-local read actions only. Trust Desk contacts no other agent site.

agent_mcp.reason: This is a static bundle; a public MCP facade requires an application host.
